=== 6 Build Overview
#h4 CHECK OUT VERSION ON GEMLING </poe-2/profile/skadoosh/builds/corrupting-cry-gemling> IN 0.5!

Stack melee levels for [Fortifying Cry] to hit everything on screen with damage over time [Paquate's Pact|supportcorruptingcryplayerthree], that also explodes everything that dies. Stack spirit with [Ancestral Bond] to summon [Ancestral Warrior Totem]'s that attack with [Earthshatter]. Detonate the spikes by spamming [Seismic Cry], recovering massive amounts of life and applying [Howling Beast|passive-wolf14] for big crits

#h3 Frequently Asked Questions

- I can't use my weapon set passive points, why? You first need normal passive points before you can split them with the weapon set points. So to apply the max 24 weapon points for each set, you first need 24 normal passive points available to use.
- How come I can't move while using [Seismic Cry]? Most likely click to move controls instead of WASD. You cannot have seismic cry on left click if you use the same button to move your character.
- Is it ok to keep [Seismic Cry] low level? Yes, and you should until you get [Second Wind III]

- How do you recover life with [Titanrot Cataphract]? [Urgent Call|passive-warcries34], [Flip the Script|passive-stun18], [Ultimate Life Flask], ([Second Wind III] unintended but OP), Gain x life per enemy killed on set 1 weapon, weaving in [Fortifying Cry]

- My [Shockwave Totem]'s die too easily? The level of the totem governs its base life. Get as much "+ levels to melee skills/attack". Totem life nodes leading to [Watchtowers|passive-totems9]. Or socket [Hardy Totems II] instead of another support

- Why is X doing so little damage? Make sure the skill is selected to work with the correct weapon set. [Ancestral Warrior Totem] and [Shockwave Totem] should always be on set 2 with your 2-hander, and warcries like [Seismic Cry] on set 1
- I don't see [Shockwave Totem] jagged ground explosions? Don't use [Persistent Ground III] or [Persistent Ground II] with [Earthquake], it disables [Shockwave Totem] explosion
=== 8 How it Works (OLD TEXT, written for 0.2/0.3 Corrupting Cry + Seismic/Infernal Cry version)

This build is built around the support gem [Corrupting Cry]. It can be linked to warcries such as [Seismic Cry] and [Infernal Cry]. Every time a warcry supported by [Corrupting Cry] affects an enemy, it applies one stack of corrupted blood.

Corrupted blood does 25% of our total strength as physical damage per second for 5 seconds. Max 10 stacks on one enemy = 250% of strength per second. Each additional stack refreshes all previous stacks. It is NOT bleed, won't scale with bleed effects (except blood loss).
[Seismic Cry] and [Infernal Cry] base cooldown 8 s ... [Warcaller's Bellow] allows us to ignore the cooldown entirely.
Why Seismic over Infernal with Corrupting Cry: lower cost, stuns, does damage, knocks back, breaks armour via [Shattering Blow|passive-stun17].

Warcry speed -> many stacks; mana drain -> [Urgent Call|passive-warcries34] and [Blood Magic] keystone; [Second Wind III] interaction for life recovery each warcry. Strength gives 2 life per point so relative life cost stays manageable.
[Corrupting Cry] falls off in single-target in endgame -> [Shockwave Totem] and weapon swapping. Weapon set points: warcry+shield passives on set 1, totem passives on set 2.
[Shockwave Totem] base duration 12 s, scaled by [Protraction|passive-duration5]; auto weapon swap when placing totems, swap back via [Seismic Cry] to shield.
Jagged Ground via [Earthquake] + [Encroaching Ground]; [Forge Hammer] (detonated via Seismic Cry) synergy; exert Forge Hammer with Infernal/Seismic Cry; [War Banner].

Patch 0.2.0 changes: Turtle Charm 25% less block (was 35%); Warcaller's Bellow scales with warcry stats; 20% more phys hit dmg vs fully broken armour; Polymathy 7% (was 10%); warcry mana cost reduced; Seismic Cry lost up to 38% warcry speed; Brutality 25% more (was 35); Swift Affliction 30% more (was 35); Against the Darkness medium radius, 3% str per notable; Morior Invictus not useful; Sceptres grant aura to allies e.g. Purity of Lightning (free resistance); Cast on Block 10x better (Svalinn); Overcharge not worth.

Patch 0.3.0 (24.08.2025): supports multiple tiers (Brutality, Corrupting Cry etc.); new warcry gem Fortifying Cry; attribute requirements lowered ~25%; Scavenged Plating 4% more armour per stack; Giant's Blood halves life from Str; The Deepest Tower removed; low level Enfeeble won't affect high mobs; [Ancestral Warrior Totem] now uses your equipped weapon (+melee levels isn't the only stat anymore); Ancestral Warrior Totem no totem limit, requires 3 Endurance Charges to place; block has old Turtle Charm effect by default, block cap 50% (was 75%); weapon swap instant; Warcaller's Bellow and Greatwolf's Howl combined (Corrupting Cry usable after first ascension); [Answered Call] now +1 totem, Ancestral Spirits much better; Renly's Training 35% base block (was 40%); [Jade Heritage] no longer loses stacks when hit (10% PDR); Seismic Cry no longer resets own cooldown by default, lost 40% warcry speed quality.
